Adreno Performance Manager allows monitoring and tuning Qualcomm Adreno GPU settings, frequency limits, governors, power constraints, and Turbo control.

1. Turbo mode and KGSL power constraint controls are designed for Qualcomm Adreno GPUs, including newer A8XX devices.
2. Turbo mode and KGSL power constraints do not require ADB or root access. Advanced sysfs frequency tuning or governor changes may require root access depending on kernel permissions.
3. Higher clock speeds and performance modes increase power consumption and device temperature.
4. GPU drivers and sysfs interfaces differ across Android vendor kernels.

Uses libadrenotools
https://github.com/bylaws/libadrenotools/
